interface.title: Citrobacter freundii resistance-island dashboard (Islands · Clusters · Antibiograms)
interface.stage_of_work: Exploring and interpreting results: browsing precomputed pangenome, island and antibiogram tables after the pipeline has run
interface.what_it_is_for: A static dashboard of three linked pages. It lines up every resistance island that carries a chosen gene, class or architecture type, shows how conserved the neighbouring genes are, opens per-gene-family protein variation and predicted structure, and compares lab susceptibility between carriers and non-carriers of a gene family.

data.note: The data ships inside the pages: Citrobacter group, 46,921 tier-1/2 islands + 19,084 tier-3 windows, 695,638 genes mapped, 12,338 architecture types, 806 analysed clusters out of 208,757 in the pangenome, 808 predicted structures, and antibiograms for 75 of 7,287 isolates (1,156 tests, 55 antibiotics). Built 2026-09-24. There are no uploads and no sign-in.
